g.text: Record functions: checkID(), addUsedID(), removeID(). No sensor-confirmed dispense or launch result is reported.
With launching enabled: coil stop > settling delay > solenoid release > record ID > wind to latch > unwind for slack.
With launching disabled: coil stop > record ID; effects still run for the configured launch-equivalent window plus a short tail.
Reset and Emergency Stop arrive as Master Mode commands. Stop halts outputs and music; LCD updates continue.
Both speakers play music normally. Timer values, startup positioning, audio transport, and SD error policy remain TBD.
